values.event_label: PR #4791: clarifies revert semantics to state that a reverting frame undoes all transient writes made between frame entry and return, including those made in inner calls (mimicking persistent storage); replaces the reference implementation with a map plus write-ahead journal list.
values.rationale: Materially clarifies normative revert behavior in nested-call cases and changes the recommended implementation strategy; both can affect implementation and testing.
values.source_title: EIP-1153: Introduce cheaper implementation, clarify semantics (#4791)

values.event_label: PR #4901: assigns concrete opcode values TLOAD=0x5c, TSTORE=0x5d for the first time; expands Security Considerations with TSTORE-vs-MSTORE memory-allocation analysis (~9.15MB per 30M gas); adds Verkle-related rationale pro.
values.rationale: First assignment of opcode byte values (an interface parameter) plus a material extension of the security analysis.
values.source_title: fix(eip-1153): add opcodes and some more info to the security considerations about memory (#4901)

values.event_label: PR #4903, same day as #4901: opcode values changed from 0x5c/0x5d to 0xb3/0xb4 to avoid conflicts with other draft EIPs; a note records the previous values.
values.rationale: Changes the assigned opcode byte values; grouped with the same-day assignment commit as one logical opcode-value update.
values.source_title: fix(eip-1153): update the copy with new opcodes 0xb3 and 0xb4 (#4903)

values.event_label: PR #4947 editorial review: adds frontmatter 'requires: 2200, 3529'; reflows prose onto single lines; removes the placeholder 'Test Cases: TBD' section and an ethereum-magicians link; minor rewording (introduces a 'themaximum' typo).
values.rationale: Bulk of the diff is formatting, but the commit introduces the EIP's formal dependency declaration on EIP-2200 and EIP-3529, which changes the declared dependency set.
values.source_title: EIP-1153 Review (#4947)

values.event_label: PR #4942: status Draft to Review; rewords TSTORE cost as 'warm SSTORE of a dirty slot'; fixes 'themaximum' typo; expands Security Considerations with detailed MSTORE memory-expansion math including a ~20MB multi-context allocation scenario.
values.rationale: Alongside the status move, materially extends the security analysis of memory-allocation costs; classified by the dominant substantive content.
values.source_title: mark EIP-1153 as review (#4942)

values.event_label: PR #4952: adds STATICCALL rule - TSTORE within a STATICCALL context must revert the call; TLOAD is allowed within STATICCALL.
values.rationale: New normative behavior constraining opcode use in static contexts.
values.source_title: add staticcall behavior to transient storage EIP (#4952)

values.event_label: PR #5028: replaces the reference-implementation sketch with a full TypeScript TransientStorage implementation (journal + checkpoints) with complexity analysis and a TryDOS Solidity example; drops the 'passing error codes' use case; rewords backwards-compatibility sentence.
values.rationale: Non-normative sections, but the expanded reference implementation and DoS analysis materially guide implementation and testing.
values.source_title: add more to the reference implementation of EIP-1153 (#5028)

values.event_label: PR #5911 'fix nit on the language': mostly formatting (frontmatter field order, blank lines after headings, EIP-20 link), but also changes the STATICCALL rule wording from 'the call must revert' to 'it will result in an exception instead of performing the modification'.
values.rationale: The STATICCALL rewording is a material clarification of normative failure semantics (exceptional abort rather than revert), despite the commit's 'nit' framing; classified substantive on that basis.
values.source_title: fix nit on the language of eip-1153 (#5911)

values.event_label: PR #6001: rewrites the use-case list (reentrancy locks, CREATE2 constructor args, temporary approvals, fee-on-transfer, till pattern, proxy metadata) and replaces the security-considerations closing paragraph with developer guidance on transient-slot lifetimes, clearing, and reentrancy risk.

values.eip_label: EIP-4788 · Beacon block root in the EVM
values.event_label: Major redesign and revival ("Move to Draft"): retitles the EIP to "Beacon block root in the EVM"; switches from exposing the beacon state root via the ommers field to appending the parent beacon block's hash tree root as a new header field; renames the opcode to BEACON_ROOT keyed by slot with a SLOTS_PER_HISTORICAL_ROOT (8192) ring buffer; adds author Ansgar Dietrichs; updates discussions-to; status Stagnant -> Draft; removes the EIP-4399/EIP-3675 background references while keeping EIP-2935.
values.rationale: Complete replacement of the exposed value (state root -> block root), commitment location (ommers -> header field), keying (block number -> slot), and storage bounding (unbounded -> ring buffer); all core normative behavior changed.
values.source_title: Update EIP-4788: Move to Draft

values.eip_label: EIP-4788 · Beacon block root in the EVM
values.event_label: "Minor nits": strengthens "should be converted to 32 bytes with big-endian encoding" to "must be converted"; corrects "requested block number" to "requested slot number"; adds "avoid breaking changes to smart contracts" to the BLOCKHASH rationale; removes stray whitespace.
values.rationale: Mostly wording, but the should->must change materially strengthens a normative encoding requirement for storage keys, which affects implementations; classified substantive on that basis.
values.source_title: Update EIP-4788: minor nits for 4788

values.event_label: "Send current slot from CL to avoid timestamp conversions": adds a second header extension (8-byte big-endian slot number) and rewrites block processing to read the last written slot from storage and iterate from start slot to end slot, writing the parent beacon block root into each ring-buffer slot.
values.rationale: Changes the header schema and the storage-update algorithm; normative behavior.
values.source_title: Update EIP-4788: send current slot from CL to avoid timestamp conversions

values.eip_label: EIP-4788 · Beacon block root in the EVM
values.event_label: "Favor stateful precompile over opcode": removes the BEACON_ROOT opcode (OPCODE_VALUE deleted) in favor of a stateful precompile at HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS read via calldata; raises G_beacon_root from 20 to 2100; removes the EIP-2935 inspiration reference.
values.rationale: Replaces the read interface mechanism (opcode -> precompile) and its gas cost.
values.source_title: Update EIP-4788: favor stateful precompile over opcode

values.eip_label: EIP-4788 · Beacon block root in the EVM
values.event_label: "Key beacon roots by root": drops the slot keying and SLOTS_PER_HISTORICAL_ROOT constant; storage is now keyed by the root itself with the header timestamp as value; removes the extra 8-byte slot header field (header extension reverts to the 32-byte root only); precompile queries by root and returns the timestamp.
values.rationale: Changes storage layout, header schema, and precompile query semantics.
values.source_title: Update EIP-4788: key beacon roots by root

values.rationale: Wholesale redesign of the mechanism from precompile to system contract with new addresses, bytecode, deployment, and block-processing semantics.

values.event_label: Typo fix in rationale ('proof' -> 'provide' the underlying data) and added trailing newline.
values.rationale: Wording/formatting only; no normative content touched.

values.event_label: Signature container field v:uint8 replaced by y_parity:boolean with EIP-1559-style recovery (v = y_parity + 27); intrinsic gas formula corrected: 21000-analog base of 20000 with 53000 for creation, EIP-2028 zero-byte calldata reduction and EIP-2930 access-list costs made explicit; simplified draft pricing reworded.
values.rationale: Changes the transaction signature data structure and the gas accounting rules; first explicit textual reference to EIP-2028 appears in the intrinsic-gas pseudocode comment.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 8500f015: EIP-4844: v -> y_parity like EIP-1559, and fix intrinsic gas (#4904)

values.event_label: Fixed blob_to_kzg helper pseudocode: undefined 'tx.blob' replaced by the 'blob' parameter and the parameter typed as Blob.
values.rationale: Corrects erroneous normative pseudocode that referenced a non-existent variable; materially clarifies the intended computation.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 22b99bb7: EIP-4844: minor fix to blob_to_kzg helper func (#4911)

values.event_label: Constants-table typo: KZG_SETUP_LAGRANGE element type BLSCommitment -> KZGCommitment.
values.rationale: Name typo in a table; the referenced type was already defined as KZGCommitment.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit e248652a: Correct typo: BLSCommitment -> KZGCommitment (#4992)

values.event_label: Copyright section link changed to the repository LICENSE file (repo-wide sweep 'Force usage of included LICENSE file').
values.rationale: License-link housekeeping applied across the repository; no EIP content change.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 9e393a79: Force usage of included LICENSE file (#5055)

values.event_label: Network-wrapper validation changed to verify versioned hashes: validate_blob_transaction_wrapper now checks kzg_to_versioned_hash(kzg) against tx.message.blob_versioned_hashes instead of a separate commitments comparison.
values.rationale: Changes the normative network-level validation algorithm for blob transactions.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 1677031e: EIP-4844: Change to versioned hashes (#5106)

values.event_label: Removed the blob-verification precompile (address 0x13, 1.8M gas) in favor of using the point-evaluation precompile everywhere; fraud-proof rationale rewritten around point evaluation.
values.rationale: Deletes an entire EVM precompile from the specification; changes execution-layer surface and rollup usage pattern.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit f45bd0c1: EIP-4844: remove blob-verification precompile in favor of using the point-evaluation precompile everywhere (#5140)

values.event_label: Mempool/network validation optimized with KZG proofs: kzg_aggregated_proof field added to BlobTransactionNetworkWrapper, KZGProof type and ROOTS_OF_UNITY constant added, lincomb/barycentric-evaluation/hash_to_bls_field/compute_powers/vector_lincomb helpers added, and validate_blob_transaction_wrapper rewritten to verify an aggregated proof.
values.rationale: Changes both the network data structure and the normative validation algorithm.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 0cf9afe1: Optimizing EIP-4844 transaction validation for mempool (using KZG proofs) (#5088)

values.event_label: Hyphenation fix: 'EIP 1559' -> 'EIP-1559' in three places.
values.rationale: Pure formatting of existing references; no content change.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit ed4b9974: fix eip refs in 4844 (#5354)

values.event_label: Removed the system-contract concept (SYSTEM_STATE_ADDRESS / TOTAL_BLOB_TXS_STORAGE_SLOT): excess-blob accounting moved into a new 256-bit header field excess_blobs with an extended RLP header encoding and calc_excess_blobs(parent, new_blobs); get_blob_gas now derives the price from the header.
values.rationale: Redesigns the blob gas-price tracking mechanism from contract storage to a block-header field; changes header encoding and validation.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 2d983426: Update EIP-4844: Remove system contract concept (#5353)

values.event_label: Prose fix: gas-price section now names the 'excess_blobs' header field (text said 'blobs').
values.rationale: Fixes an incorrect field-name reference in prose introduced by the system-contract removal; the pseudocode already used excess_blobs.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 510f932a: fix extra blob (#5629)

values.event_label: Intrinsic gas base left at G_transaction = 21000 (previous commit had lowered the blob-tx base to 20000 as an SSZ discount).
values.rationale: Changes a concrete gas parameter in the specification.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 30bdab9e: fix(4844): leave G_transaction at 21000 (#5636)

values.event_label: Added Mofi Taiwo (@Inphi) to the author list.
values.rationale: Author-metadata change only.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 059f1c3d: EIP-4844: Add @Inphi to author list (#5658)

values.event_label: get_intrinsic_gas/get_blob_gas signatures changed to take the parent Header instead of ExecState, and the stale 'gas cost depends on pre-state' note removed, completing the header-based accounting change.
values.rationale: Materially clarifies which data the normative gas computation reads after the system-contract removal; a leftover inconsistency could otherwise mislead implementers.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit fdbd8d84: fix signature to use `Header` rather than `ExecState` (#5672)

values.event_label: Transaction field renamed max_basefee_per_gas -> max_fee_per_gas to match EIP-1559 terminology; trailing-whitespace cleanup.
values.rationale: Pure identifier rename for clarity; the SSZ container layout, types, and semantics are unchanged, so no implementation-visible behavior changes.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 3a4633ef: Update 4844: use clearer name for max fee value (#5671)

values.event_label: Inline cryptographic helpers (lincomb, blob_to_kzg, verify_kzg_proof, barycentric evaluation, hash_to_bls_field, compute_powers, vector_lincomb) removed; the EIP now normatively references the pinned ethereum/consensus-specs eip4844 documents (polynomial-commitments.md, validator.md) at commit 6c2b46ae; KZG_SETUP_G2/KZG_SETUP_LAGRANGE/ROOTS_OF_UNITY constants dropped and wrapper validation delegates to compute_aggregated_poly_and_commitment.
values.rationale: Delegates normative cryptography to an external pinned specification (a repository, not an EIP, so it is recorded here and not in dependency_history); changes the validation text.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit ae32e77e: Synchronize EIP-4844 cryptography with consensus specs (#5649)

values.event_label: Markdown lint fixes: bullet style '*' -> '-' and blank lines around lists.
values.rationale: Formatting only.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 0dbfc7ac: fix linting (#5860)

values.event_label: Fee-market redesign ('Fee Market Update', PR #5707): introduced data gas as an independent gas type with MAX_DATA_GAS_PER_BLOCK=2**21, TARGET_DATA_GAS_PER_BLOCK=2**20, MIN_DATA_GASPRICE=1, DATA_GASPRICE_UPDATE_FRACTION=8902606; fake_exponential rewritten to a factor*e**(num/denom) Taylor form; transaction gains max_fee_per_data_gas and priority_fee_per_gas renamed max_priority_fee_per_gas; header field excess_blobs -> excess_data_gas; new block validity conditions (balance covers data fee; max_fee_per_data_gas >= current data gasprice); data_fee burned and non-refundable; mempool recommendations rewritten.
values.rationale: Wholesale change to the blob fee-market mechanism, parameters, transaction fields, header field, and validity rules. Also removes get_intrinsic_gas and with it the EIP's only EIP-2028 reference (see dependency_history).
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 7e8d2629: Update EIP-4844: Fee Market Update (#5707)

values.event_label: Punctuation consistency in two rationale list items.
values.rationale: Formatting only.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 6642a5b8: Fixed punctuation inconsistency (#5884)

values.event_label: Declared EIP-4895 (beacon chain withdrawals) a dependency: frontmatter requires gains 4895 and the extended header RLP is restated in its post-merge/withdrawals form (withdrawals_root, prev_randao, difficulty 0, constant ommers hash) with excess_data_gas appended after withdrawals_root.
values.rationale: Adds an explicit cross-EIP dependency and fixes the normative header layout the EIP extends.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit f3513815: 4844: declare withdrawals in 4895 as a dependency (#5906)

values.event_label: Throughput reduced: MAX_DATA_GAS_PER_BLOCK 2**21 -> 2**19 and TARGET 2**20 -> 2**18 (max 4 / target 2 blobs, ~0.5/~0.25 MB), DATA_GASPRICE_UPDATE_FRACTION 8902606 -> 2225652; new 'Throughput' rationale section; security-considerations sizes updated.
values.rationale: Changes concrete protocol parameters governing blob throughput.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 89b85203: [EIP-4844] Reduce Throughput (#5863)

values.event_label: Added Ansgar Dietrichs (@adietrichs) to the author list.
values.rationale: Author-metadata change only.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit df2cb5f6: EIP-4844: Add adietrichs as co-author (#6006)

values.event_label: Fork-boundary rule added: for the first post-fork block, parent.excess_data_gas is evaluated as 0.
values.rationale: Materially clarifies normative behavior at activation; implementations need this rule.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit cf0e8277: add fork block clarification (#6020)

values.event_label: Point-evaluation precompile output changed from empty bytes to FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB and BLS_MODULUS as two 32-byte values; rationale section 'Versioned hashes & precompile return data' added explaining upgradability.
values.rationale: Changes the precompile's observable return interface.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 1226bfec: [EIP-4844] Return Modulus From Precompile (#5864)

values.event_label: Crypto API simplified and synced with consensus-specs (pin 6c2b46ae -> a4562716): precompile pseudocode rewritten with explicit versioned_hash|z|y|commitment|proof input layout, and wrapper validation now calls verify_aggregate_kzg_proof directly.
values.rationale: Changes normative validation pseudocode and the referenced external crypto API.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit e3ffeeb0: EIP4844: Update crypto API (simplify precompile / sync with consensus-specs) (#6002)

values.event_label: Networking rule added: nodes must not automatically broadcast blob transactions; they are announced via NewPooledTransactionHashes and fetched via GetPooledTransactions; mempool rationale rewritten around announcement-based control, citing EIP-5793; 1.1x data-gasprice replacement bump recommended.
values.rationale: Adds a normative networking requirement; introduces the EIP-5793 textual reference (see dependency_history).
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 3358a80d: Update EIP-4844: Disable Blob Transaction Broadcast (#5930)

values.event_label: Precompile return encoding specified as padded 32-byte big-endian values (to_be_bytes32).
values.rationale: Materially clarifies the byte-level return interface introduced by the modulus-return change; endianness is implementation-affecting.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit ec66af41: clarify endianness (#6026)

values.event_label: Removed the testing-only 'Gas price of blobs (Simplified version)' section and the SIMPLE_GAS_PER_BLOB constant; dropped the stale claim that the SSZ transaction type is gas-advantaged by a 1000 discount.
values.rationale: Removes a spec section and constant (explicitly marked testing-only) and corrects the rationale to match the 21000 base-gas decision; classified substantive because a constant and an alternative pricing path leave the specification.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 60d04c40: Update EIP-4844: small clarification (#6035)

values.event_label: Precompile MUST reject non-canonical field elements (inputs strictly less than BLS_MODULUS); precompile description reworded; consensus-specs pin bumped to 23d3aeeb.
values.rationale: Adds a normative validation requirement with security relevance.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 7eac5f7f: EIP4844: Be explicit about precompile accepting canonical inputs (#6082)

values.event_label: Defined the hash of a signed blob transaction: keccak256(BLOB_TX_TYPE + ssz.serialize(tx)).
values.rationale: Specifies a previously undefined normative identifier computation for the new transaction type.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 43ee7f9e: clarify signed blob transaction hashing (#6238)

values.event_label: Signing-hash computation changed from keccak256(BLOB_TX_TYPE + ssz.hash_tree_root(tx.message)) to keccak256(BLOB_TX_TYPE + ssz.serialize(tx.message)); tx_hash renamed unsigned_tx_hash.
values.rationale: Changes the digest over which blob-transaction signatures are computed - a consensus-relevant behavior change.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 7cd2762b: change blob tx_hash to use serialize instead of hash_tree_root to make it more consistent with computing the regular blob tx hash (#6241)

values.event_label: kzg_to_versioned_hash explicitly uses sha256 (was the generic 'hash').
values.rationale: Materially clarifies which hash function implementations must use.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 9dbb2489: EIP-4844: Explicitly state sha256 is used (#6345)

values.event_label: DATAHASH opcode semantics made precise: reads index from the top of the stack as big-endian uint256 and replaces it with the versioned hash, or a zeroed bytes32 when out of range.
values.rationale: Materially clarifies normative EVM stack behavior (endianness, in-place replacement, zero value shape).
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 739e75c9: Update EIP-4844: clarify datahash return value (#6348)

values.event_label: Status moved from Draft to Review.
values.rationale: EIP process metadata; no specification content change.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 01d32099: EIP-4844: update to Review status (#6030)

values.event_label: SSZ list bounds tightened: MAX_TX_WRAP_KZG_COMMITMENTS and LIMIT_BLOBS_PER_TX reduced from 2**24 to 2**12.
values.rationale: Changes concrete limit parameters of the network data structures.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 2783d144: More sane limits on blobs per transactions (#6500)

values.event_label: Block validity extended: the header's excess_data_gas must equal calc_excess_data_gas(parent, num_blobs) computed over the block's transactions.
values.rationale: Adds an explicit consensus validation rule for the new header field.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 29a250cc: Update EIP-4844: validate excess_data_gas in block header

values.event_label: Point-evaluation precompile input length must be exactly 192 bytes (assert len(input) == 192).
values.rationale: Adds a normative input-validation rule to the precompile.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit e933fb32: Update EIP-4844: check input length of the precompile

values.event_label: BLOB_TX_TYPE changed from 0x05 to 0x03.
values.rationale: Changes the transaction type identifier - a consensus-relevant parameter.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit a120da48: Update EIP-4844: change blob transaction type to 0x03

values.event_label: Zero-blob transactions banned: blob_versioned_hashes must be non-empty both in network wrapper validation and in execution block verification.
values.rationale: Adds a normative validity rule.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 193c6b5a: Update EIP-4844: Ban Zero Blob Txs

values.event_label: calc_data_fee pseudocode inconsistency fixed: get_data_gasprice(header) -> get_data_gasprice(parent), matching the function's parameter.
values.rationale: Corrects erroneous normative pseudocode (undefined variable); materially clarifies which header the fee is computed from.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 3c574340: Update EIP-4844: amend inconsistency in calc_data_fee

values.event_label: Blobs decoupled ('Decouple blobs'): the network wrapper carries a per-blob proofs list instead of a single kzg_aggregated_proof and validation uses verify_blob_kzg_proof_batch; consensus-specs pin moved to the deneb directory (86fb82b2); transaction field renamed blob_versioned_hashes -> versioned_hashes and wrapper fields renamed; MAX_TX_WRAP_KZG_COMMITMENTS -> MAX_TX_WRAP_COMMITMENTS.
values.rationale: Changes the network data structure and validation algorithm (per-blob proofs replace the aggregate proof).
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 84f61365: Update EIP-4844: Decouple blobs

values.event_label: De-SSZified the specification: the blob transaction is now an EIP-2718 RLP TransactionPayload rlp([chain_id, nonce, ..., max_fee_per_data_gas, blob_versioned_hashes, y_parity, r, s]) with a keccak256-over-RLP signing digest and a defined ReceiptPayload; SSZ containers (SignedBlobTransaction et al.) and the TransactionNetworkPayload framework removed; gossip wrapper redefined as rlp([blob_tx_payload, blob_kzgs, blobs, blob_kzg_proofs]); SSZ-related rationale removed.
values.rationale: Wholesale change of the transaction encoding, signing, receipt, and networking formats from SSZ to RLP.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 8703d20f: Update EIP-4844: de-sszify spec

values.event_label: Instruction mnemonic renamed DATAHASH -> BLOBHASH.
values.rationale: Name-only change: the opcode byte (HASH_OPCODE_BYTE = 0x49), gas cost, and semantics are unchanged, so no implementation-visible behavior changes; classified non-substantive as a rename.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit f9661490: Update EIP-4844: change op to `BLOBHASH`

values.event_label: Typo fix: 'a list hash outputs' -> 'a list of hash outputs'.
values.rationale: Grammar only.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 04ca241e: Update EIP-4844: Update eip-4844.md, fix typo

values.event_label: Validity conditions refactored into 'Consensus layer validation' and 'Execution layer validation' sections; validate_block consolidated: balance check made conditional per transaction type, per-blob-tx checks (non-empty hashes, version byte, data gasprice) moved into block validation, and an explicit block-level assertion block_data_gas <= MAX_DATA_GAS_PER_BLOCK added; calc_excess_data_gas now takes consumed_data_gas.
values.rationale: Restructures and extends the normative block-validity algorithm, adding an explicit block data-gas limit check.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit ed615691: Update EIP-4844: Refactor Validity Conditions

values.event_label: Networking cleanup: gossip wrapper renamed to rlp([tx_payload, blobs, commitments, proofs]) with blobs defined as big-endian-flattened BLSFieldElement lists; validation list consolidated (equal counts, hash match, proof match); added execution-validity assertion that tx.to != None.
values.rationale: Changes the wrapper element definitions/ordering and adds the first form of the no-contract-creation rule for blob transactions.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 4ad3886f: Update EIP-4844: Cleanup transaction network payload references

values.event_label: Rationale wording: blobs are 'coupled with the beacon block' instead of 'go into the BeaconBlockBody'.
values.rationale: Prose clarification in the rationale; no normative change.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit abb8b8c8: Update EIP-4844: clarify blob coupling

values.event_label: Header gains a new 64-bit data_gas_used field; excess_data_gas is now computed from the parent header alone via calc_excess_data_gas(parent) (using parent.data_gas_used); block validation asserts both header fields.
values.rationale: Adds a consensus header field and changes the excess-data-gas update/validation rules.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 635e9c21: Update EIP-4844: add `data_gas_used` to header

values.event_label: Blob-transaction 'to' field MUST NOT be nil (blob transactions cannot be create transactions); per-field semantics of the payload spelled out; the redundant in-block assertion removed in favor of the field rule.
values.rationale: Makes the no-contract-creation rule an explicit normative field constraint.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit f5179fa1: Update EIP-4844: clarify to must be non-nil

values.event_label: excess_data_gas header field reduced from 256-bit to 64-bit unsigned integer.
values.rationale: Changes the size/encoding of a consensus header field.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 7aeca8e2: Update EIP-4844: reduce size of `excess_data_gas` to 64 bit

values.event_label: Precompile inputs z and y specified as padded 32-byte big-endian values.
values.rationale: Materially clarifies the byte-level input encoding of the precompile.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 3ed24020: Update EIP-4844: Specify precompile input's  z and y to be encoded as big endian

values.event_label: Blob throughput increased to target 3 / max 6 blobs: MAX_DATA_GAS_PER_BLOCK = 786432, TARGET_DATA_GAS_PER_BLOCK = 393216, DATA_GASPRICE_UPDATE_FRACTION = 3338477; abstract and security-considerations figures updated (~0.375/~0.75 MB).
values.rationale: Changes concrete protocol parameters governing blob throughput.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 2511e0bc: Update EIP-4844: Increase Blob Throughput

values.event_label: Throughput rationale section updated to the new 3-blob target / 6-blob maximum figures.
values.rationale: Aligns rationale prose with the parameter change in the same logical update; no new normative content.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 2a2a4c01: Update EIP-4844: Adjust Throughput Section

values.event_label: TransactionPayloadBody defined: the TransactionPayload is the RLP serialization of the listed body, and the gossip wrapper element changed from tx_payload to tx_payload_body.
values.rationale: Resolves an encoding ambiguity with wire-format consequences: embedding the body list versus the already-RLP-serialized payload inside rlp([...]) produces different bytes.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit e9a4295f: Update EIP-4844: clarify transaction payload body

values.event_label: POINT_EVALUATION_PRECOMPILE_ADDRESS changed from 0x14 to 0x0A.
values.rationale: Changes the precompile address parameter.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit b9a5a117: Update EIP-4844: Update precompile address for 4844
